communications.communication:
RE: Flock Safety ALPR Audits

To the FOIA Officer of Aurora Police Department,

This request is made under the provisions of Illinois Freedom of Information Act. for the following records:

1. Organization Audit in Flock.
The report should include data logged from the period of August 1, 2026 to August 31, 2026. Per Flock's documentation, the Organization Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches done within the agency.

2. Network Audit in Flock.
The report should include data logged from the period of January 1, 2026 to August 31, 2026. Per Flock's documentation, the Network Audit is available within the Insights tab and is defined as searches of the organization’s Flock network by any agency in the Flock System.

The records requested above are generated automatically by the vendor platform (Flock Safety) and exported directly as pre-compiled native electronic files (CSV) via the system's administration dashboard. This Department has previously fulfilled identical requests for these native audit exports spanning multiple months (e.g., covering June 2025 through February 2026 under tracking reference P000538-020226) without asserting any administrative or undue burden. https://www.muckrock.com/foi/aurora-7505/flock-safety-alpr-audits-2026-q1-aurora-police-department-203951/

Because these electronic logs require no manual data compilation, reformatting, custom report creation, or redaction of substantive text fields, extracting and transmitting these native files involves minimal operational impact.

Please provide the audit data in a structured format such as .csv, .xls, or another machine-readable database filetype.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the case of any applicable fees, it is requested that an estimate of the total charges be provided prior to fulfilling this request. The preferred method of receipt is through electronic delivery.

Your assistance and cooperation in this matter are greatly appreciated. A response within 5 business days, as the statute requires is anticipated.

Best,
N/A

title: FEMA PA First Appeals Pending Decision — Companion to FEMA-2026-FEFO-00955

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: FEMA PA First Appeals Pending Decision — Companion to FEMA-2026-FEFO-00955
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

On August 19, 2026, FEMA issued its final response to my FOIA request FEMA-2026-FEFO-00955 (filed through MuckRock as request 
#213233), producing in full one spreadsheet exported from the tracking system that FEMA's Office of Response & Recovery uses to track Public Assistance first appeal decisions issued under 44 C.F.R. § 206.206. That production covered decided appeals only.

I request an export from the same tracking system of all Public Assistance first appeals pending decision — that is, received at any FEMA region but with no first appeal decision yet issued — as of the date this request is processed. For each pending appeal, please include the following fields to the extent they are maintained: Region; Disaster Number; Applicant; PA ID #; PW #(s); Amount in Dispute; Appeal Received at Region; and any status, stage, or assignment field FEMA tracks for pending appeals. The Appeal Received at Region date is essential.

Two notes on scope. First, the system that produced the prior report necessarily distinguishes appeals with issued decisions from those without; this request seeks the complement of the prior search — the same tracking-log fields for the appeals not yet decided. Second, I am requesting docketing information only: dates, identifiers, amounts, and status. I am not requesting drafts, recommendations, or any internal analysis of pending appeals.

Please produce the records as an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx), delivered electronically, and route this request to the office that handled FEMA-2026-FEFO-00955.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Richard Brady

title: FLOCK HISTORY AUDIT REQUEST FOR GEORGIA NORTHERN JUDICIAL DISTRICT COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPORTMENTS (Hart County Sheriff's Office)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To all relevant open record personnel: 

Public reports state that this county is using cameras from Flock Safety (a.k.a. "Flock"), the automatic license plate reader (ALPR) company. For the purposes of this request, when I refer to "Flock products," this includes hardware (Flock License Plate Readers (LPRs), Flock Safety Falcons, Flock Video Cameras, Flock Mobile Security Trailers, Flock Gunshot and Audio Detection Devices, Flock Drone as First Responder (DFRs), and Flock Alpha) as well as software (Flock Safety Platform, FlockOS, Flock911, Flock Nova, Flock FreeForm, Flock Vehicle Fingerprint technology, and the National LPR Network). Source:
https://www.flocksafety.com/products


Therefore, pursuant to Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records (dated September 19, 2026 to the time this request is processed):
1. All contracts, purchase orders, invoices, receipts, payment records, budgetary quotes, and related procurement records involving Flock Safety.

2. All training, instructional, presentation, and guidance materials concerning the use of any Flock Safety product or service, including hardware and software. This includes, but is not limited to:
a) Presentations, videos, audio recordings, scripts, manuals, and training materials;
b) Meeting notes discussing the use of Flock products;
c) Technical or operational explanations of how Flock products function; and
d) Internal or external documents used to explain, train on, or promote the use of Flock products.

3. All policies, procedures, agreements, and legal documents relating to Flock Safety or its products, including terms and conditions, privacy impact assessments, standard operating procedures, use policies, data retention policies, legal opinions, warranties, nondisclosure agreements, memoranda of understanding, liability waivers, insurance agreements, and any other formal or informal agreements.

4. All audit, oversight, or compliance records relating to Flock Safety or its products, including security audits, misuse investigations, and reports submitted to oversight bodies.

5. All records reflecting requests from other law enforcement agencies or private entities for data obtained through Flock products, including but not limited to requests for LPR data.

6. All communications and documents that reference
"Flock" / "Flock Safety," including emails, text messages, PDFs, word processing documents, spreadsheets, presentations, etc.

7. All communications with representatives of Flock Safety (email domain: @flocksafety.com) and any and all reports and data of your audits you have made as an agency yourself or have been subject to by any flock audits. 
Please try to include any other miscellaneous documents that facilitate this municipality's relationship with Flock that don't neatly fall neatly into the above categories.
I am a policy analyst for https://www.shirleyhuman.com/, so the requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes. Therefore, I request that any fees are waived. But in the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available. I also respectfully ask that my request is expedited, given the newsworthiness of Flock and its activities.

If you need to contact me, you can reach me at info@ShirleyHuman.com or 706-498-4275. Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Hanna Davison
